______________________________________________________________________

JUGEMENT

______________________________________________________________________

[
1
]

Le Tribunal est saisi d'une déclaration, déposée
par une personne dûment mandatée par le Directeur de la protection de la
jeunesse, aux fins de faire réviser une ordonnance rendue le 7 octobre 2005.

[
2
]

Cette ordonnance était à l'effet de confier
l’enfant à sa mère et à cela s'ajoutaient diverses mesures d'aide et de
soutien.

[
3
]

Les motifs invoqués au soutien de cette
procédure sont énoncés en son paragraphe 4 qui se lit comme suit :

4.          Since the above-mentioned
decision or order was rendered, the following new facts have arisen :

a)         the child has
remained in the mother’s care;

b)         on or around the end of October
2005, the family began the Family Preservation Program;

c)         until December 2005, the mother
was collaborating with the Family Preservation Program;

d)         on December 22
nd
,
2005, the mother moved with the child;

e)         since, the mother is not
complying with the program nor meeting consistently with the workers;

f)          the mother has admitted that
Mr. B has resurfaced and is present in their lives;

g)         coincidently, the child’s
behaviour is deteriorating in school more particularly but not restrictively,
in that :

i)          the child, on one
occasion, hit a peer;

ii)          the child is not completing
his homework consistently;

iii)         the child is disruptive in
class;

iv)        the child is disrespectful;

h)         the child is currently on a
waiting list at school to be assessed by a psychologist;

i)          on
March 1
st
, 2006
, the child disclosed that Mr. B is
regularly physically aggressive towards him;

j)          the child verbalizes that the
most recent incident occurred on February 28
th
, 2006 whereby Mr. B
hit him twice while the mother was in the home;

k)         the mother is not taking the
necessary steps to protect the child;

l)          on
March 1
st
, 2006
, the child asked that he be removed from
the mother’s home;

m)        on that said date, urgent measure
were invoked and the child was placed in a foster home;

[
4
]

La situation de l’enfant X est à peu près celle
qui est décrite au paragraphe 4 de la déclaration et plus amplement détaillée
dans l'étude de la situation sociale déposée par le Directeur au moment de
l'audition de cette affaire.

[
5
]

La mère, présente à l’audience et représentée
par avocate, admet l’essentiel des faits allégués à la déclaration, tout en
faisant certains commentaires sur les rapports déposés à l’audience.

[
6
]

Elle accepte également de s’engager dans les
mesures proposées par le Directeur.

[
7
]

L’avocate représentant le jeune informe le
Tribunal que ce dernier doit s’impliquer dans le programme proposé par le
Directeur.

[
8
]

Considérant l'ensemble de la preuve documentaire
et testimoniale et considérant les admissions des parties, le Tribunal conclut
que l’ensemble des faits allégués ont été prouvés et que la sécurité et le
développement de l’enfant X sont et demeurent compromis.

[
9
]

Le Tribunal est d'avis que les mesures
recommandées par le Directeur sont dans l'intérêt de l’enfant.

[
10
]

PAR CES MOTIFS, LE TRIBUNAL :

[
11
]

GRANTS
the
petition ;

[
12
]

DECLARES
that the
security or development of the child continues to be in danger;

[
13
]

REVISES
the
decision or order rendered on October 7
th
, 2005;

[
14
]

ORDERS
X to be
entrusted to the care of his mother for a period of nine months;

[
15
]

ORDERS
that if
accepted in the Jewish General Hospital Day Treatment Program, Ms. A co-operate
with the treatment by being able to be contacted, keeping her appointments and
following their recommendations;

[
16
]

O
RDERS
that Ms. A follow the recommendation made in the psychological
assessment ordered by the court, if not accepted by the Jewish General Hospital
Day Treatment Program;

[
17
]

O
RDERS
that Ms. A to seek individual therapy to deal with her own personal
issues, if not accepted by the Jewish General Hospital Day Treatment Program;

[
18
]

O
RDERS
that Ms. A be assessed for her parental capacity in relationship to
Tyrone, if not accepted by the Jewish General Hospital Day Treatment Program;

[
19
]

O
RDERS
that X is enrolled in a community recreational activity and if
accepted,
ORDERS
Batshaw to provide the necessary help;

[
20
]

O
RDERS
that X is enrolled in a treatment program for children that have
witnessed conjugal violence, if not accepted by the Jewish General Hospital Day
Treatment Program;

[
21
]

O
RDERS
that Ms. A refrain from using any form of physical correction;

[
22
]

O
RDERS
that Ms. A inform the Director of Youth Protection of any changes
in her living environment;

[
23
]

A
UTHORIZES
the Director of Youth Protection to obtain relevant information,
pertaining attendance, motivation and progress, from any and all professionals
providing services to the child, including Dr. Linda Greenberg and her
treatment team at the Jewish General Hospital Department of Psychiatry;

[
24
]

F
ORBIDS
contact between Mr. B and X;

[
25
]

O
RDERS
that aid, counsel and assistance be provided to the child and his
family for a period of nine months;

[
26
]

ORDERS
Director
of Youth Protection to organize a meeting between the mother and the
psychologist, in order to explain the child’s psychological report, dated April 28, 2006;

[
27
]

ENTRUSTS
the
situation of the child, X, to the Director of Youth Protection of Batshaw Youth
and Family Centres, who shall then see that the measures are carried out;

[
28
]

ORDERS
the
execution of the present decision by any peace officer.
